description: Every source file that can open a network connection, with the reviewed number of call sites. tests/core/network-egress-inventory.test.ts fails when a file gains, loses or changes network call sites until this record is reviewed. scope: external = leaves the computer; loopback = only 127.0.0.1 between Monarch processes; configured = an endpoint the owner configured. The renderer (src/ui/public) is guarded by its Content-Security-Policy (connect-src 'self') instead.
